cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Tell Me Why
cards.instruction: Get someone to reveal the motive behind a choice by offering small pieces of your own truth as bait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've turned Leah's photo face down like you. Keeping things private. I once hid an invitation because I felt left out. Why hide mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's to stop the sun fading it. I hid yours because you'd have gone without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Photo protected, yes. I nearly skipped your birthday when you invited Leah. Is this about being alone?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's about you liking her more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I counted your photos with her after that party. Did you hide my invitation to make me choose you?

reason: Copied photo concealment assumption becomes face-saving cover as A trades personal jealous details for B increasingly precise motive.
